needs_ledger.plain: The September statement is pinned and gives the 12 to 0 vote and target range.
The implementation note is pinned and gives the September 17 effective date and operating rates.
The release and full 17-page projection record are pinned and read.
The full 15-page press conference transcript is pinned and read.
The July statement is pinned and compared line by line with September.
Both daily target series and their metadata pages are pinned through September 19.
The Federal Reserve's history table confirms that the previous increase was July 27, 2023.
The official calendar puts regular-meeting minutes three weeks after the decision, making the September minutes due October 7.
Twelve coverage records spanning the preview, result, consumer effects, reaction, policy dispute and follow-up are pinned and checked.
The July PCE release fixes the August PCE and annual national-account updates on September 30.
The CBO article body was recovered from a dated archive after the direct fetch returned 403.

sources_admitted.evidence: Thirty-one records have registry run ids, repository pins, recomputable text hashes and verified quote spans or an explicit typed capture limitation.

derived_numbers_computed.evidence: The data module parses the two admitted CSV series and computes the rate path, vote, 279-day duration, observation count, percentile and October 7 minutes date.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: The working note checks each admitted outlet against the statement, projections, transcript, prior statement or series and labels overreach.

section_grammar.evidence: The story follows the reader-model order: decision, mechanism, household effects, projections, the checked CBS overstatement, political pressure, aftermath, unknowns and records.

chip_vocabulary.evidence: All source details use SourcedBlock kind record; no page-specific chip label is introduced.

live_elements_guarded.evidence: The page contains no live element; all records and series carry fixed September 19 vintages.

subject_page_updated.evidence: The subject module now carries the September range and vote, and the subject chart imports the September rate path.

homepage_updated.evidence: Discovery imports the new event, whose event.visual supplies the homepage card table.
